title: 第14章  重伤的美人
content_zh:
野兽山岭，楚弛依旧在猎杀野兽。
此时，他微微皱起了眉头，轻喃道。
“奇怪，进来三天了，都没有见到我哥。他能猎杀的野兽，也就一级六阶，最多一级七阶，应该就在这个圈子。该不会是出事了吧？”
“我在想什么呢，呸呸呸，野兽山岭这么大，没遇到哥哥，也在情理之中。继续猎杀野兽吧！”
“嗯？那是死人吗？”
楚弛忽然停下了脚步，他在一处阴暗的角落，发现了一道人影。
此人，躺在地上，一动不动。
人影背对着楚弛，楚弛看不清楚对方的容貌。
但楚弛确定，这是一位女子。
而且，这位女子的身材非常完美。
她躺在地上，露出s形曲线，那白皙修长的腿，更是让人移不开目光。
楚弛快速靠近女子，发现女子身上没有外伤，而且女子有呼吸，并没有死去。
他将女子的身体翻过来，那一瞬间，他瞳孔不停收缩。
这女子，太美了。
美到他都不知道如何去形容。
之前碰到女剑仙，他以为女剑仙是世上最美的女子。
但眼前的女子，却比女剑仙，还要漂亮。
最重要的是，这女子，没有女剑仙那种高高在上，拒人于千里之外的感觉。
“嗯？不对劲。她的脸，怎么黑了？”
楚弛忽然皱起了眉头。

女子那美丽的脸蛋，以肉眼可见的速度，出现了密密麻麻的黑线。
她的嘴角，更是溢出了血迹。
“这是五步蛇的尸体，她中毒了！”
楚弛在女子身体旁边，发现了被扯成两半的五步蛇尸体。
五步蛇，蕴含巨毒。
被咬后，十秒之内就会陷入昏迷。
五分钟之内不解毒，或者将毒吸出去，天王老子来了也救不活。
看女子脸上的黑线，估计时间也快到了，再不救就来不及了。
原本，楚弛是不会随便救一个陌生人的。他可不是什么好心肠的人。
但俗话说，颜值即正义！
这么美的女人，死在自己面前，那真的是暴殄天物。
“女人，你运气不错，遇到了乐于助人，号称妇女之友的我。或许还有救！”
楚弛蹲下身体，抱起了女子修长的腿。
伤口，就在小腿上。
女子皮肤细腻光滑，只是触碰，就激起了楚弛心中的那片火！
他感觉体内的血液，开始沸腾了。
楚弛有些惊讶，同女剑仙大战了三百年，他还以为，他的欲望，已经减退，没有以前那么强烈了。
此刻他才发现，他的欲望不是减退了。
而是一般的女人，根本提不起他的欲望。
楚弛恨不得将女子压在身上，好好快活一番。

但，他虽然好色，却不下流。
君子好色，取之有道。
这种趁人之危的事情，他做不出来。
他抱起女子的腿，将毒血吸了出来。
一边吸，一边吐。
黑色的血，逐渐变得鲜红了起来。
女子脸上的黑线也越来越少。
看来这女子的确是命不该绝。
当所有黑血全部被吸出来后，楚弛拿出水壶，不停漱口。
口腔里的毒血，一丁点都不能吞下肚子，否则，他也会中毒。
将水壶里的水全部用尽，楚弛这才罢口。
他低头看了一眼女子，女子的脸色，已经变得红润。
这让女子显得更加美丽了，但女子还是没有醒来。
此时，楚弛的目光不自主地从女子的脸部，移到身体，随后是修长的双腿……
原本压制下去的欲望，又起来了。
他快要控制不住自己了！
他很想知道，裙子下面是什么风光。
此刻，他的脑海里出现了一个邪恶的声音。
“掀开看看吧，反正只是看看，她又不吃亏！你都救了她的命了？看看又能怎么呢？”
这个想法一出，一发不可收拾。

楚弛的手，下意识就放在了裙摆之上。随后，微微抬起。
好风光！
楚弛盯了好久，才恋恋不舍地松开了手。
此时他的脑海里，又出现了一个声音。
“光看有什么意思，不如摸一摸！”
摸一摸？这不好吧！
“有什么不好的。反正摸一摸，她也没有什么损失。只要你不说，谁知道这些事情。还是那句话，要是没有你，她命都没了！”
有道理！
楚弛的手，还是不受控制伸了出去。
他心里在叹息，果然，男儿本色啊！
这可怨不得他！
何况，他是荒古大日体。
但，就在他的手要触碰到女子的时候，女子睁开了双眼。
一睁眼，女子就看见楚弛目露霪光的样子。
“霪贼，找死！”
女子发出了尖叫声，随后，她伸出纤纤玉手指着楚弛的脑袋。
她的指尖，有灵光闪现。
但这灵光只是一闪而逝，女子猛地吐出一口鲜血，身体倒在了地上。
楚弛这才开口道：“你醒了？你别误会，我是在给你整理裙子。刚才有点走光了！”
“整理裙子？”

女子明显不信，但随后像是想到了什么，她开口道：“我应该中毒了才对。”
楚弛回答道：“你不是应该中毒了，是已经中毒了，是我，将毒吸出来的，不然，你早就死了。”
“是你救了我？等等，你说将毒吸出来？用嘴？”
女子下意识抱住了自己的腿。
楚弛白了女子一眼，道：“不用嘴能用哪里？用屁股啊？”
“你！我……”
女子咬住嘴唇，那秀眉微蹙的样子，别有一番味道。
这种小女态，哪怕是女剑仙身上也没有。
好一会，女子才接受了这个事实，她咬牙开口道：“谢谢你。”
“这才对嘛，我救了你。你当然该谢谢我。”
女子白了楚弛一眼，又问：“这里是哪里？”
楚弛奇怪地道：“你不知道这是哪里，那你怎么来的这里？难道你是被人打晕，拐到这里来的？该不会，你已经被人给……哎，可惜可惜。”
“你回答我……”
女子眉头一皱，隐隐有些恼怒。
楚弛耸了耸肩，道：“这里是野兽山岭。”
“野兽山岭？没听过。你告诉我，这里是哪个国家？”
“还能有哪个国家？当然是大元国。你，是不是脑子有问题？怎么感觉傻兮兮的。”
女子没有回答，而是轻喃道：“一个微不足道的小国家吗……”
“美女，你在说什么？”
“没什么。”

女子忍住身体的不适，强行站了起来。
但她的伤势真的太重了，连站都有些摇晃。
“你，叫什么名字？”女子再次开口。
“楚弛。”
“楚弛，多谢你救了我。我的身体，受伤太严重，我得先找个地方，好好修养一番。你家住哪里的？等我能正常走动，就去找你，我不会白白受别人的恩情。”
楚弛打量着女子的身体，好奇地道：“怎么，你要报答我？以身相许吗？”
“你！想多了！”
“不是以身相许，难道，一夜情？也行，我还可以不负责任。”
“无耻！”
女子脸色瞬间变红。
楚弛却是洒脱一笑道：“你怎么知道我的小名！”
content_en:
In the Wild Beast Mountain, Chu Chi is still hunting wild beasts.
At this time, he frowned slightly and murmured softly.
"It's strange. I haven't seen my brother since I came here for three days. The beasts he can hunt are only level one and six, and at most level seven, they should be in this circle. Could something have happened?"
"What am I thinking, bah bah bah, the Beast Mountain is so big, it makes sense that I didn't meet my brother. Keep hunting the beasts!"
"Huh? Is that a dead person?"
Chu Chi suddenly stopped and found a figure in a dark corner.
This man was lying on the ground, motionless.
The figure's back was turned to Chu Chi, and Chu Chi couldn't see the other person's face clearly.
But Chu Chi was sure that this was a woman.
Moreover, this woman has a perfect figure.
She was lying on the ground, revealing her S-shaped curves, and her fair and slender legs made people unable to take their eyes away.
Chu Chi quickly approached the woman and found that there were no external injuries on the woman's body, and that the woman was breathing and not dead.
He turned the woman's body over, and at that moment, his pupils kept shrinking.
This woman is so beautiful.
It was so beautiful that he didn't know how to describe it.
When he met the female sword fairy before, he thought she was the most beautiful woman in the world.
But the woman in front of him is even more beautiful than the female sword fairy.
The most important thing is that this woman does not have the feeling of being aloof and repelling others thousands of miles away like the female sword fairy.
"Huh? Something's wrong. Why is her face dark?"
Chu Chi suddenly frowned.
Dense black lines appeared on the woman's beautiful face at a speed visible to the naked eye.
The corners of her mouth overflowed with blood.
"This is the body of a five-step snake. She was poisoned!"
Next to the woman's body, Chu Chi found the body of a five-step snake that had been torn in half.
The five-step snake contains huge poison.
After being bitten, you will fall into coma within ten seconds.
If you don't detoxify or suck out the poison within five minutes, even if the King of Heaven comes, you won't be able to save him.
Judging from the black lines on the woman's face, it is estimated that the time is almost up and it will be too late if we don't save her.
Originally, Chu Chi would not just save a stranger. He is not a kind-hearted person.
But as the saying goes, appearance is justice!
It would be a waste of resources for such a beautiful woman to die in front of him.
"Woman, you are lucky to have met me who is helpful and known as a friend of women. Maybe there is hope!"
Chu Chi knelt down and hugged the woman's slender legs.
The wound is on the calf.
The woman's skin was delicate and smooth, and just touching it aroused the fire in Chu Chi's heart!
He felt the blood in his body begin to boil.
Chu Chi was a little surprised. After fighting with the female sword fairy for three hundred years, he thought that his desire had subsided and was not as strong as before.
Only now did he realize that his desire had not diminished.
But ordinary women can't arouse his desire at all.
Chu Chi wished he could press the woman on top of him and have a good time.
However, although he is lecherous, he is not obscene.
A gentleman is lustful and takes it in a wise way.
He couldn't do this kind of thing while taking advantage of others.
He picked up the woman's leg and sucked out the poisonous blood.
Suck it in and spit it out.
The black blood gradually turned bright red.
The black lines on the woman's face are getting fewer and fewer.
It seemed that this woman really did not deserve to die.
When all the black blood was sucked out, Chu Chi took out the kettle and rinsed his mouth.
Don't swallow even a little bit of the poisonous blood in your mouth, otherwise, he will also be poisoned.
After using up all the water in the kettle, Chu Chi stopped talking.
He glanced down at the woman, whose face had turned rosy.
This made the woman look even more beautiful, but the woman still did not wake up.
At this time, Chu Chi's eyes moved involuntarily from the woman's face to her body, and then to her slender legs...
The desire that had been suppressed rose again.
He can't control himselfGot it!
He wanted to know what was underneath the skirt.
At this moment, an evil voice appeared in his mind.
"Open it and take a look. It's just a look anyway. She won't suffer! You saved her life? What can you do if you just take a look?"
Once this idea came out, it was out of control.
Chu Chi's hand was subconsciously placed on the hem of her skirt. Then, lift it up slightly.
What a sight!
Chu Chi stared at it for a long time before reluctantly letting go of his hand.
At this time, another voice appeared in his mind.
"What's the point of just looking at it? Why not touch it!"
Touch it? This is not good!
"What's wrong? Anyway, if you touch her, she won't lose anything. As long as you don't tell, who knows these things. Again, without you, her life will be dead!"
Makes sense!
Chu Chi's hand still stretched out uncontrollably.
He sighed inwardly, as expected, what a man is!
You can't blame him!
What's more, he is the Great Sun of Ancient Times.
But just when his hand was about to touch the woman, the woman opened her eyes.
As soon as she opened her eyes, the woman saw Chu Chi's eyes shining brightly.
"Thief, you are seeking death!"
The woman screamed, and then she stretched out her delicate fingers and pointed at Chu Chi's head.
There was a flash of inspiration at her fingertips.
But the aura only flashed away, and the woman spit out a mouthful of blood and fell to the ground.
Chu Chi then said: "Are you awake? Don't get me wrong, I was fixing your skirt. It was a little naked just now!"
"Fixing your skirt?"
The woman obviously didn't believe it, but then she seemed to think of something and said, "I should be poisoned."
Chu Chi replied: "It's not that you should have been poisoned. You have already been poisoned. It was me who sucked the poison out. Otherwise, you would have died long ago."
"Did you save me? Wait, you said suck the poison out? With your mouth?"
The woman subconsciously hugged her legs.
Chu Chi rolled his eyes at the woman and said, "If you don't use your mouth, where can you use it? Use your butt?"
"You! I..."
The woman bit her lip, her beautiful eyebrows slightly furrowed, and there was something special about her.
This kind of petty femininity is not found even in the female sword fairy.
After a while, the woman accepted this fact. She gritted her teeth and said, "Thank you."
"That's right, I saved you. Of course you should thank me."
The woman rolled her eyes at Chu Chi and asked, "Where is this?"
Chu Chi said strangely: "You don't know where this is, so how did you get here? Did you get knocked unconscious and abducted here? Could it be that you have been given... Oh, what a pity."
"Answer me..."
The woman frowned, slightly annoyed.
Chu Chi shrugged and said, "This is the Beast Mountain Range."
"Beast Ridge? Never heard of it. Tell me, which country is this?"
"What other country could there be? Of course it's the Great Yuan Kingdom. Are you having a brain problem? Why do you feel so stupid?"
The woman did not answer, but whispered: "Is it an insignificant little country..."
"Beauty, what are you talking about?"
"Nothing."
The woman endured the discomfort and forced herself to stand up.
But her injuries were so serious that she was shaking even when standing.
"What's your name?" the woman asked again.
"Chu Chi."
"Chu Chi, thank you for saving me. My body is too seriously injured. I have to find a place to recuperate first. Where do you live? When I can move around normally, I will find you. I will not accept others' kindness in vain."
Chu Chi looked at the woman's body and said curiously: "What, you want to repay me? Will you pledge yourself to me?"
"You! You're thinking too much!"
"Isn't it a one-night stand? It's okay. I don't have to be responsible."
"Shameless!"
The woman's face turned red instantly.
Chu Chi smiled freely and said: "How do you know my little one?"name! "
